items.exampleEn: His voice is instantly recognizable on the radio.
items.exampleZh: 他的聲音在廣播上一聽就認得出來。

items.exampleEn: He only has a superficial knowledge of history.
items.exampleZh: 他對歷史只懂一點皮毛。

items.exampleEn: The two colors are complementary and look good together.
items.exampleZh: 這兩種顏色互補，搭在一起很好看。

items.exampleEn: Eggs are a versatile food: you can boil, fry, or bake them.
items.exampleZh: 蛋是很多用途的食材：可以水煮、油煎，也可以烘烤。

items.exampleEn: The purity of the gold is tested before it is sold.
items.exampleZh: 黃金在出售前會先檢驗純度。

items.exampleEn: The phone has a metal exterior that does not scratch easily.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機有金屬外殼，不容易刮傷。

items.exampleEn: The view from the top of the mountain was phenomenal.
items.exampleZh: 從山頂看出去的景色好得驚人。

items.exampleEn: The report contained some revealing facts about how people spend their time.
items.exampleZh: 這份報告包含一些揭露人們如何運用時間的事實。
items.glossZh: 透露內情的；揭露真相的

items.sentenceEn: The exterior of the house needs a fresh coat of paint.
items.sentenceZh: 這棟房子的外牆需要重新上一層漆。

items.audioEn: After ten years, the town center is barely recognizable; most of the old shops have gone.
items.audioZh: 十年過去，鎮中心幾乎認不出來了；大部分的老店都不見了。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得鎮中心怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: Her performance in the final was phenomenal.
items.sentenceZh: 她在決賽中的表現驚人。

items.sentenceEn: The damage to the car was only superficial.
items.sentenceZh: 車子的損傷只是表面上的。

items.stemEn: A good team has members with ____ skills, so each person covers the others' weak points.
items.stemZh: 好的團隊成員擁有互補的技能，所以每個人都能補足其他人的弱點。

items.stemEn: This jacket is so ____ that I wear it to work and on hikes.
items.stemZh: 這件夾克用途很廣，我上班和健行都穿它。

items.passageEn: When Anna first opened her tea shop, she painted it in bright colors. In a revealing interview, she later admitted that this first design was superficial: the colors hid poor service. "I learned that good service matters more than looks," she explained. So she changed everything. She chose a plain white exterior and a small green sign that is easily recognizable from the street. Her teas are known for their purity: she adds no sugar or flavors. Since then, the shop's success has been phenomenal. The business has flourished, and she now runs three shops. Her versatile staff can make tea, bake cakes, and run events.
items.passageZh: Anna 剛開茶店時，把店漆成鮮豔的顏色。後來在一次坦露內情的訪談中，她承認這最初的設計很膚淺：鮮豔的顏色掩蓋了不好的服務。她解釋：「我學到好的服務比外觀更重要。」於是她全面改造：選了素白的外觀，以及從街上很容易認出來的綠色小招牌。她的茶以純正聞名：不加糖，也不加香料。從那之後，這家店的成功非比尋常。生意蒸蒸日上，她現在經營三家店。她多才多藝的員工會泡茶、烤蛋糕，也會辦活動。

questions.questionZh: 在訪談中，Anna 說她學到了什麼？
options: 鮮豔的顏色能吸引客人
員工只需要會泡茶就好

items.promptZh: 這間飯店的服務真是太棒了。
referenceEn: The service at this hotel is phenomenal.
This hotel's service is truly phenomenal.
rubricZh: phenomenal 表示「驚人的、非凡的」（例如 the service is phenomenal 等）
加強語氣可寫，例如 truly、really 等，不加也可以
「這間飯店的服務」可寫，例如 the service at this hotel、this hotel's service 等

items.promptZh: 她是一位多才多藝的演員，能演喜劇也能演悲劇。
referenceEn: She is a versatile actor who can play both comedy and tragedy.
She is a versatile actress; she can act in comedies as well as tragedies.
rubricZh: 「多才多藝」用 versatile（例如 a versatile actor 等）
「能演喜劇也能演悲劇」可寫，例如 both comedy and tragedy、comedies as well as tragedies 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：閱讀邏輯矛盾：開頭說 Anna 開店時就選了素白外觀、希望每個細節都簡單，後面卻說她「最初的設計」很膚淺、用了鮮豔顏色；時間線對不上。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改寫時間線：先寫開店時漆成鮮豔顏色、後來在訪談中承認最初設計膚淺，「於是她全面改造」才選了素白外觀；閱讀兩小題不變

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：revealing 釋義「發人深省的」不準確（那是 thought-provoking）；revealing＝透露內情的、揭露真相的。閱讀 passageZh「一次發人深省的訪談」也應改為「坦露內情的訪談」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: revealing 釋義改為「透露內情的；揭露真相的」，短文中譯改「一次坦露內情的訪談」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 uncharacteristic、nonprofessional 為冷僻長字且跨課重複（u04-l07、u05-l03、u06-l04），一眼可排除。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 干擾項改為 superficial（本課）、antiquated（u02-l02）、startling（u04-l02），皆已教過的形容詞，只有 complementary 能接後半句

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 干擾項 complementary 與 q13 同課重複，且只有一個干擾項放得進形容詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 recognizable、crude（形容詞，放得進 so ____ that 但語意不通）與 purity

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：phenomenal 表示「驚人的、非凡的」（例如 the service is phenomenal 等）／加強語氣可寫，例如 truly、really 等，不加也可以／「這間飯店的服務」可寫，例如 the service at this hotel、this hotel's service 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：versatile 表示「多用途的」，位置有彈性（例如 a versatile knife、is versatile 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（versatile）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u04-l03-q17；目標字沿用 versatile
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「她是一位多才多藝的演員，能演喜劇也能演悲劇。」、hintWords ["versatile"]、referenceEn ["She is a versatile actor who can play both comedy and tragedy.","She is a versatile actress; she can act in comedies as well as tragedies."]、rubricZh ["「多才多藝」用 versatile（例如 a versatile actor 等）","「演員」可寫，例如 actor、actress 等","「能演喜劇也能演悲劇」可寫，例如 both comedy and tragedy、comedies as well as tragedies 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 versatile 造一個句子，介紹一樣你覺得用途很多的東西。」、referenceEn ["My favorite kitchen tool is a versatile knife that I use every day.","I think a scarf is a versatile gift for almost anyone."]）
